classification: unmodified pinned upstream implementation with original isolated entry/write-error observation adapter
changes: No upstream echo algorithm or source changes; no shell/Bash/native-host fallback.

Linux native closed-stdout suppression remains an upstream/Rust qualification limit; normal flags/escapes and /dev/full failures are compared with GNU.
Echo build is separate from the pre-existing grouped coreutils invocations; root Cargo workspace/lock changed, so previous producer input digests are not relabelled.
